package handlers

import "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"

type paginationMeta struct {
	Page       int `json:"page"`
	Limit      int `json:"limit"`
	TotalItems int `json:"total_items"`
	TotalPages int `json:"total_pages"`
}

func buildPaginationMeta(pageValue *int, limitValue *int, totalItems int) paginationMeta {
	page, limit, _ := filters.NormalizePagination(pageValue, limitValue)
	totalPages := 0
	if totalItems > 0 {
		totalPages = (totalItems + limit - 1) / limit
	}
	return paginationMeta{
		Page:       page,
		Limit:      limit,
		TotalItems: totalItems,
		TotalPages: totalPages,
	}
}
